Name: (CP)(AT) Wood Lattice Wallpapers
Author: Pixeltica
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/gObHXZa.png[/img][/center]
A huge collection that adds more than 1250 new wallpapers made from:
[list]
[*]32 unique wood lattice pattern designs
[*]5 wood frame recolors (1 custom + 4 vanilla base ones)
[*]8 background color variants (4 light and 4 dark)
[/list]
You can now choose to add the wallpapers through [b]Content Patcher[/b] or [b]Alternative Textures[/b].

[b]Content Patcher:[/b]
Make sure to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and download the CP version of the mod. New wallpapers are added directly to the walls & floors catalogue and Happy Home Designer one if you have it installed, without replacing any of the existing vanilla or modded ones. 

[b]Alternative Textures:[/b]
Make sure to install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod and download the AT version of the mod. To use the wallpapers purchase your preferred tool at Robin's. Wallpapers can be applied using the Paint Bucket tool, but will also be available via the Happy Home Designer Catalogue if you have it installed.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/SA4UIAY.png[/img][/center]
This applies to the CP version ONLY: use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to enable and disable parts of the pack, based on their background color. Your choices will be reflected in the catalogues immediately.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/6jqjNHy.png[/img][/center]
Due to the large number of options I highly recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer Catalogue[/url] for better viewing and usage experience!

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Dlmu3nF.png[/img][/center]
Please let me know in case of any issues with the textures or the config - when reporting bugs please make sure to include a [url=https://smapi.io/log/]SMAPI log[/url].

The "in game" screenshot features:
> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28043]Kisaa's Tiny Rooms Pack for PIF[/url] (amazing cozy spaces to decorate!)
> Wooden Floor from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12743]IdaIda's Wallpapers and Floors
[/url]> [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]
> And furniture from my upcoming Cozy Modern Furniture Pack
